---
title: "GHG Inventory Project Hub"
toc: false
---

This repository is the coordination hub for the U.S. Greenhouse Gas Inventory (GHGI) pipeline. It holds the schema registry, methodology narratives, cross-cutting rules, and project conventions that every source-category repository depends on. It does not pull, transform, or calculate emissions data; that work happens in the source-category repositories.

The documentation follows the [Diátaxis](https://diataxis.fr/) framework, which sorts each document by what the reader needs at that moment.

## How-to guides

Task-focused steps for someone who already knows what they want to do.

- [Render the documents](how-to/render-the-documents.qmd)
- [Maintain the schema](how-to/maintain-the-schema.qmd): which files to edit, and how to rebuild and validate
- [Query the schema](how-to/query-the-schema.qmd)

## Reference

Facts to look up while working: rules, definitions, and specifications.

- [Project conventions (AGENTS.md)](reference/conventions.qmd): the source of truth for coding, unit, tooling, and project-management conventions
- [Schema](reference/schema.qmd): source categories, the dataset registry, and their crosswalk
- [Schema explorer](reference/schema-explorer.qmd): browse the category tree, the datasets each category uses, and where each dataset lives
- [Schema data dictionary](schema/schema-dictionary.html): the column-level dictionary for the schema tables, with a diagram of how they relate
- [Cross-sector boundary rules](reference/cross-sector-boundaries.qmd): which sector reports each emission
- [Methodology narrative standard](reference/narrative-standard.qmd): the required format for a category's methodology narrative (draft)
- [Example methodology narrative: wastewater](reference/methodology/sample-smn-wastewater.qmd)
- [Glossary](reference/glossary.qmd)

- [Architecture and design principles](explanation/architecture.qmd), including open decisions and review milestones
- [Component build checklist](explanation/build-checklist.qmd): every component of the production system, ordered by dependency, with current status

## Source material

Working notes to draw on when writing documentation. These are not specifications, and nothing should be built or cited from them directly.

- [Inventory methods compilation](source-material/inventory-methods-compilation.qmd): inventory methods restated by category, with early coding notes. Being replaced category by category by methodology narratives.

## Tutorials

Learning-oriented lessons for newcomers. None yet; a natural first tutorial would walk a new contributor through one source category from narrative to validated output.
